import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import compiler
from compiler import participant_distance, Router, _adjacency, _candidate_orders, _decompose_trees
from collections import defaultdict
# patch _deliver to report the failing receiver
orig = compiler._deliver
def patched(router, v, rv, order, names, n, dist, recipes, memo, strict=False):
    have = {w:0 for w in names}; have[v]=rv
    lv=defaultdict(int); out=[]
    partset=set(names); senders_all=[v]+[w for w in names if w!=v]
    for _p in range(8):
        prog=False
        for w in order:
            need=rv-have[w]
            if need<=0: continue
            pool = [v]+order[:order.index(w)] if strict else senders_all
            cands=[u for u in pool if have.get(u,0)>0 and u!=w]
            cands.sort(key=lambda u:(dist.get((u,w),99),u))
            for u in cands:
                need=rv-have[w]
                if need<=0: break
                cap=min(have[u],need)
                if cap<=0 or dist.get((u,w),99)==99: continue
                allowed=set(range(n))-(partset-set([u,w]))
                fl=router.route_max(u,w,cap,allowed)
                if fl is None: continue
                got=sum(c for _,c in fl)
                if got: lv[(u,w)]+=got; have[w]+=got; prog=True
        if all(have[w]>=rv for w in names): break
        if not prog: break
    if any(have[w]<rv for w in names):
        print('FAIL v=%d missing=%r' % (v, [w for w in names if have[w]<rv]))
        return None
    return (lv, out)
compiler._deliver = patched
m=16
links=[(i,(i+1)%m) for i in range(m)]
parts=[(i,1) for i in range(m)]
caps=[8]*m
plan = compiler.build_plan(m, links, caps, parts, {i:1 for i in range(m)})
print('built', plan is not None)
